The '''Lingcod''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] or [[Cindersap Forest]]) or the [[The Mountain|Mountain Lake]] during [[Winter]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|120}}.

Lingcod can be caught regardless of season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Tailoring==
Lingcod can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]].  [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Lingcod can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The primary output is dark brown Lingcod [[Roe]], but [[Bug Meat]] is also possible starting at population 9.

==Quests==
*[[Willy]] requests a Lingcod by mail on the 13th of [[Winter]] (year 2) in the [[Quests#Catch a Lingcod|"Catch a Lingcod" Quest]].  The reward is {{Price|550}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart. Note that you can use a Lingcod caught before the quest was accepted.
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Lingcod to be caught in [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
